_what: which trainer declares --w-tac-goal; every count paired with a same-breath positive control (add_argument, def main) and a negative control (a nonsense flag). A zero from an unread file is INCONCLUSIVE, never absence.
_why: the brief specified the v7-tiny rig (~19 M params). The flag under test is not in that trainer at all, so the sweep had to run on refc_v3_train.py -- the refcv6 arm-C trainer itself.
verdict: train_v6_staged.py (the v7-tiny trainer) does NOT declare --w-tac-goal: 0 occurrences against a positive control of 232 add_argument calls in the same read. refc_v3_train.py declares it 12 times. The head under test therefore cannot be exercised on the v7-tiny rig.
